rows.behavior: kmctl's APM package lives in packages/kmctl/apm (with its claude and antigravity sub-packages), kmaudit's version lives in packages/kmaudit/apm/apm.yml, and neither apm/ at the root nor packages/kmaudit/VERSION remains; both wheels build at the version their apm.yml names, kmctl's with its skills, agents and rules.
rows.fails_when: apm/ or packages/kmaudit/VERSION still exists, a wheel's version differs from its apm.yml, or kmctl's wheel lacks _skills, _agents or _rules

rows.behavior: release.py reads kmctl's version from packages/kmctl/apm/apm.yml and kmaudit's from packages/kmaudit/apm/apm.yml, set writes them and pins the moved hook hints, and manifest falls back to apm/apm.yml on a commit from before the move; the release workflow stages the moved files and release-tag triggers on both apm.yml paths.
rows.fails_when: a version is read from or written to the old place, manifest fails on a pre-move commit, or a workflow names apm/apm.yml or packages/kmaudit/VERSION as a current path

rows.behavior: new_entry writes path packages/kmctl/apm for this CLI; plugin patch and doctor recognise kmctl's entry and its sub-packages under path apm and packages/kmctl/apm; doctor's update fix for a project with {path: apm, ref: v0.12.2} names path packages/kmctl/apm and this CLI's ref.
rows.fails_when: an entry under either path goes unrecognised, new_entry writes path apm, or the update fix gives only a ref
rows.command: uv run pytest packages/kmctl/tests/test_plugin.py packages/kmctl/tests/test_doctor.py packages/kmctl/tests/test_plugin_patch.py -q

rows.behavior: The starter renders path apm for kmctl_ref v0.12.2 and older and path packages/kmctl/apm after it, and just bootstrap in a project generated at a release after the cutoff installs the package from packages/kmctl/apm with doctor passing.
rows.fails_when: a render names the wrong path for its ref, or the bootstrap fails
rows.command: uv run pytest packages/kmctl/tests/test_starter.py -m 'not integration or integration' -q

rows.behavior: Every v* tag after the cutoff has packages/kmctl/apm/apm.yml and packages/kmctl/pyproject.toml and no apm/apm.yml; every older tag the reverse.
rows.fails_when: a tag's layout disagrees with the cutoff for either move
rows.command: uv run pytest packages/kmctl/tests/test_pin.py -m integration -k cutoff_matches_tags -q

rows.behavior: The Antigravity rules hook's files: pattern and scripts/sync_antigravity_rules.py work on packages/kmctl/apm, and the APM package, Antigravity and OpenCode tests read the moved package.
rows.fails_when: the hook's pattern does not match a rule under packages/kmctl/apm, the sync reads or writes apm/, or any of those tests fails
rows.command: uv run pytest packages/kmctl/tests/test_apm_package.py packages/kmctl/tests/test_antigravity.py packages/kmctl/tests/test_opencode.py -q

rows.behavior: The repository's skills and audit tests read the skills and agents from packages/kmctl/apm.
rows.fails_when: any of those tests fails or still reads apm/
rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_skills.py tests/test_audit.py tests/test_release_skill.py -q
